calls.video_title: Great time for Indian Markets? (after Trump's loss) | Akshat Shrivastava
calls.thesis: The AI story is intact and no bubble is bursting: AI is penetrating almost every segment, valuations are reasonable (Google 19 PE), and AI backers have bipartisan support; he is cutting some Indian equities to move more money into AI stocks
calls.base_case: High-quality AI names bought on discount compound over 2-3 years without needing a short-term sale
calls.bull_case: AI earnings keep growing ~20% and the discounted names re-rate
calls.bear_case: Cheap, fast debt issuance dries up and AI capex fails to convert into profits
calls.note: First Akshat call on the US AI theme (Rahul Jain's earlier SELL does not count - flips are per creator). Specific names beyond Google are reserved for his community, so only the theme-level call is recorded.

calls.video_title: S Naren's 36 Years of Investing Wisdom in 45 Minutes | The Legend Speaks | Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: Globally extreme valuations in AI stocks; in India also be careful of US-AI-based growth stories - take money out from a contrarian angle
calls.base_case: Trim exposure to overvalued AI growth stories
calls.bull_case: AI earnings compound and valuations sustain
calls.bear_case: An unpredictable trigger ends the AI rally sharply
